name: Barbell hip thrust
definition: Position the upper back against a fixed bench, feet on the floor and a padded bar across the hips. Raise the pelvis through hip extension, then lower back to the chosen bottom position.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Position the upper back against a fixed bench, feet on the floor and a padded bar across the hips.
value.movement: Raise the pelvis through hip extension, then lower back to the chosen bottom position.
value.finish: Finish with the hips lowered and the bar retained in position.
value.range_of_motion: Repeatable hip travel; stop the lift at the selected torso/thigh alignment without adding a trunk-extension target.
